en: An old black‑and‑white postcard view of an urban street intersection. Cobblestone streets are lined with multi‑story stone buildings with shops on the ground floor and tall windows above. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the square, and there are streetlamps and tram tracks or rails visible. The printed caption at the top identifies the scene as Jerntorget with Andra Långgatan in Göteborg (Gothenburg), and there is a reference number and museum credit at the bottom.
